headline: FTAI Infrastructure Plans $270M Private Notes Offering for DRUbit Acquisition
summary: FTAI Infrastructure plans to offer $270 million in private notes to fund the acquisition of DRUbit LLC.
why: FTAI Infrastructure owns and acquires critical infrastructure assets, utilizing debt offerings for corporate expansions.

impacts.name: FTAI Infrastructure Inc.
impacts.why: Issuing private notes increases corporate leverage to fund targeted asset acquisitions.
